workflow.title: Review MacBooster's System Junk before cleaning Xcode data
workflow.primaryIntent: Separate documented generated Xcode data from downloads, backups and personal files in a broad junk scan; decide what must be rebuilt or retained before cleanup.
workflow.leadDirection: Start with review, not Fix All. MacBooster documents Xcode Derived Data and iOS logs, but its junk categories also include downloads/backups; category membership alone is not deletion permission.
outline: Open with labelled Breathing Room current-source example visual; disclose affiliation at recommendation, not hidden in footer.
Explain MacBooster's documented System Junk Details and configurable categories, with linked official illustration until permission cleared.
Use a decision checklist: generated/rebuildable, original/backup, unknown owner; retain unknowns and verify backup/rebuild costs.
Distinguish scan results, deletion method, Trash moves and actual free space; no savings claim.
Compare targeted owning-tool cache methods and observation in Breathing Room without denying MacBooster's Xcode categories.
State when MacBooster's broader suite fits, when a maintenance preview does not, and unresolved licence terms.
workflow.interactionPass: Draft-stage decision aid: category -> owner known? -> reproducible? -> backup needed? -> review/retain. No filesystem access or cleanup actions; explain that totals are not permission. This is a handoff requirement, not implemented UI.
workflow.visualPlan: Space example preview immediately after lead; official System Junk Details image later only after rights/inspection gate clears.
prohibitions: No fabricated hands-on workflow or performance result.
No blanket recommendation to delete Xcode directories, logs, downloads, backups or language files.
Do not reproduce vendor claims that junk can be removed without a second thought.

structure: Bounded conclusion with 'Breathing Room, which we build'.
Fact matrix referencing claim IDs for OS/licence, review model, developer categories, monitoring, hosted boundary and price uncertainty.

comparison.pricingRule: Show only attributed advertised offers with explicit unresolved terms after gate resolution; never call $3.33/$4.99 actual monthly billing or omit the free-scan/paid-fix distinction.

macbooster: Documented duplicate/photo, malware, uninstall/reset and startup tools give broader scope than the verified Breathing Room register; no measured efficacy claim.
Manual documents category review and Xcode-specific cleanup; not merely a one-click black box.
Free scanning does not mean free fixing; current licence terms conflict. Photo deletion/duplicate-alias behavior needs careful review, not blanket recoverability assumptions.
breathingRoom: Source-backed app/helper sampling, growth observation and exact-action approvals can suit investigation; these are not comparative benchmarks or proof MacBooster lacks monitoring.
Free local core plus optional hosted AI Care is not the same licensing model as a scan-only unregistered utility.

Non-notarized preview, Python prerequisite, incomplete clean-machine/Intel validation, hosted data sharing/authentication and running-app daily-care constraints can make it the wrong choice. Not a verified antivirus or photo-dedup replacement.
